tasks.question: What is an e-mail?
Which is a correct e-mail address format?
What does the 'Subject' field mean?
options: A short summary or title of the email

tasks.question: What is an 'attachment' for?
options: Sending files (pictures, documents) together with the letter

tasks.question: What does 'CC' (Carbon Copy) mean?
options: Only for names starting with C
Sends a copy to someone we want to keep informed

tasks.question: What does 'BCC' (Blind Carbon Copy) mean?
options: A copy where other recipients don't see who else got it

tasks.question: Which button can you use to answer a letter?
What is the 'Forward' button for?
options: Sending the received letter to someone else

tasks.question: Where can you find received letters?
Where are unfinished letters stored?
What should you do if you receive a suspicious letter from an unknown sender?
options: Delete it without opening or report as spam

tasks.question: What is a signature at the end of an email?
options: A preset text with your name and details

tasks.question: Is it okay to send very large files as attachments?
options: No, because it can fill the recipient's mailbox or fail to send

tasks.question: Why is the greeting important at the beginning of the letter?
options: Because it is part of basic politeness

tasks.question: Which of these is NOT a free email service?
What does the '@' symbol mean?
options: The mandatory separator of an email address

tasks.question: How do you end a letter politely?
Why is it worth filling in the 'Subject' field?
options: Helps the recipient know what the letter is about
Because the computer won't send it without

tasks.question: What does 'Reply All' mean?
options: Send an answer to all friends
Answer everyone who was in the original correspondence

tasks.question: What is the spam folder?
What is the search in email for?
options: Finding older letters based on keywords

tasks.question: Can you get a virus through email?
options: Only if you don't have a password

tasks.question: How can you send an email to many people at once?
options: Enter all addresses in the recipients field

tasks.question: What is an email account?
options: A real drawer in the desk
A storage space on the internet where letters are stored

tasks.question: What should you do if you forgot your password?
options: Use the 'password reminder' or 'forgot password' function

tasks.text: Always write a short, relevant subject for your letter!
Attachments allow us to send files.
The '@' sign must always be in an email address.
Never open suspicious attachments from strangers!
Use a polite closing at the end of formal letters!
You can find your incoming letters in the Inbox folder.
You can save unfinished letters in Drafts.
Do not send very large images by email!
Electronic mail is fast and efficient.
